items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025

ctx.x: Okay so you have a friend who has a son or daughter who wants to do what you do, and they’re 16. Do you have any specific advice for them?

That’s so difficult. That is so difficult because it really has changed a lot. You know younger people ask about this, like what of my own experience can help them as young © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

people. [Sorry I’ve got the sun in my face.] And the business is so radically different now that I’m not sure that my — I always doubt that my own experiences are even appropriate anymore. The last time I saw Quincy Jones he actually sort of asked me this, he said, “How do you think young people get started today in this business?” And I had to say I have no idea. And he didn’t either.
